name: example-site
_comment: Copy this file somewhere outside the repository, replace the patterns with
the naming schemes your own estate uses, and point HIDER_PROFILE at it.
Do not commit a filled-in profile: identifier formats describe your
topology, which is part of what the redaction layer exists to hide.
A profile can only ADD patterns. It cannot weaken a built-in recognizer,
and anything malformed here is a startup error rather than a silent skip.
Entries are a regex string, or an object with 'regex' and 'score'.
